question: Identify the solution extracted from a plant belonging to division Thallophyta.
solution:
The correct option is** __Litmus solution.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• **Thallophytes or Thallophyta**__ are a polyphyletic group of non-mobile organisms having same characteristics but do not share a common ancestor.
 
• **Thallophyta **is categorized as a sub-kingdom of kingdom **__Plantae__.**
 
• These includes **Lichens,Algae,Bacteria and Bryophytes.**
 
• Unlike other plants, xylem and phloem are absent.
 
• They are usually found in moist or wet places.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The division Thallophyta, is classified into two subdivisions: 

 
 
• **Algae**
 
• **Fungi​​**
 
 
 
• **​Algae, **are chlorophyll-bearing thalloid. They are autotrophic and largely aquatic plants.
 
• **Fungi, **are achlorophyllous (meaning: they do not produce chlorophyll) heterotrophic thallophytes.**​**
